title: gold_canonical.communication_log
description: Canonical Gold — CRM communication metadata (email/SMS send events). One document per (tenantId, communicationLogId), passthrough from silver.communication_log (source table lives in EACH TENANT'S OWN database, immutable/append-only, monthly-partitioned). Deliberately excludes body_snapshot/body_tokens/to_address/from_address — confirmed NULL on every row today and DPO-gated regardless. See docs/crm/eden_crm_gold_requirements.md G5.

sourceEnv.description: Silver _s_env. Part of the upsert key.

_env.description: Deployment tier that wrote this doc (PIPELINE_ENV) — different axis from sourceEnv.

communicationLogId.description: Grain key. silver.communication_log.id is a UUID column (confirmed 2026-09-25) — not the auto-increment int convention most other ported source tables use.

subject.description: Subject line only — never body content.

occurredAt.description: Also the source table's monthly partition key.

customerUuid.description: Soft reference to gold_canonical.customer — nullable (a communication can precede customer creation, i.e. sent to a lead). Not a real FK by design.

projectId.description: The project's ORDER NUMBER (silver.project.order_no), resolved via communication_log.project_id -> silver.project.id (confirmed 2026-09-25) — deliberately not the raw FK value. Nullable: a communication can be logged before a project exists (e.g. a pre-conversion lead's welcome email).

providerMessageRef.description: Provider-side correlation id (Twilio SID, email provider id) — debug/audit only.

isDeleted.description: Expected always false — source rows are immutable/append-only (a DB trigger blocks UPDATE). Kept for consistency with every other canonical loader.
